## benchmark_paillier.json — Paillier additive baseline
Linear score only; each of the 11 features is encrypted separately. Decimal wire sizes are estimates and are not directly comparable to OpenFHE binary serialization.
Security note: Functional smoke only: this key size is not secure or comparable to HEStd_128_classic.
Sample: 60 test records × 1 repetition(s); full fixed test set.

## benchmark_paillier_3072b_5records.json — Paillier additive baseline
Linear score only; each of the 11 features is encrypted separately. Decimal wire sizes are estimates and are not directly comparable to OpenFHE binary serialization.
Security note: 3072-bit modulus is a conventional approximate 128-bit comparison point; not a formal parameter equivalence.
Sample: 5 test records × 3 repetition(s); deterministically evenly spaced from the fixed test set.
